legend.en: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.

effect.en: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: All too aware of their vital role in holding the foe at bay, these battle-brothers refuse to yield to even the most grievous of wounds.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: The Black Templars will see their oaths upheld at any cost. Any foe with the temerity to impede them in this goal must be put mercilessly to the sword.

when.en: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks: Have [LETHAL HITS]. Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

legend.en: The largest manifestations of the foe's sin are branded unholy abominations, challenges which a crusade's champions gladly meet to drive their sanctified weapons deeply beneath their hides.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

legend.en: Those who attempt to flee their rightful death only stroke their executioners' hatred all the hotter. None can be spared the God-Emperor's wrath.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

effect.en: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

legend.en: With roared litanies and incendiary hatred, the Sword Brethren plunge into their foe like a white-hot blade, their armoured momentum cracking armour, crushing bones, and trampling the foe underfoot.

when.en: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.

effect.en: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

legend.en: To face the Emperor’s transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.

when.en: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.

target.en: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

effect.en: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

legend.en: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe’s dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight of their thralls.

when.en: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

legend.en: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

legend.en: Perhaps guided by visions from the Emperor, Black Templars can pick out heresy wherever it lurks.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s: BS and WS. Hit rolls.

legend.en: The warrior priests of a crusade drive Sigismund’s heirs into the heart of battle, daring the greatest abominations to face their spiritual strength.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1. Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

legend.en: With a zealous cry, the Black Templars press forward, using their ceramite-armoured bulk to smash into the foe and overwhelm the enemy’s lines.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.

effect.en: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
